data.short_meaning: One who possesses good virtues and prosperity
data.long_meaning: Gunaakar is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that is derived from the words 'guna' meaning virtue, and 'akar' meaning to make or to do. This name signifies someone who possesses good virtues and has the ability to create prosperity in their life. This name is often given to a child as a blessing for a good future. The name Gunaakar carries the meaning “One who possesses good virtues and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Gunaakar usually hope their child will grow to embody one who possesses good virtues and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
